source_semantics.review: Individually review all four complete files and ten hunks of the original leaf aria-expanded fix. The host binding returns null for leaves and the actual expansion state for nonleaves. Exact changed CDK/Material assertions expect null on leaves and false/true on expandable nodes; one recursive nested-tree callback additionally marks for check. All59 cases retain identity and54 complete callbacks are unchanged.
